title: validate-json-schema: support the 'maximum'/'minimum' numeric keywords
description: Sibling of FR-VAPORIZE-JSON-SCHEMA-PATTERN-KEYWORD-SUPPORT-2026-07-06. The validator refused LOUDLY (correct behavior) on cuj-schemas v0.0.1 cuj.schema.json: "unsupported schema feature: keyword 'maximum' (instance path /c)" — the CUJModel chrononID and k/st ordinals declare minimum+maximum bounds. Consequence: every CUJ record validation falls back to the manual required[]/type check, so the whole cuj-schemas family is outside mechanical validation. Repro: vaporize.cli validate-json-schema --schema <cuj.schema.json> --fixture <any .cuj.json> --expect pass. The refusal is the tool working ([[tooling-silent-fallback-to-wrong-state-not-error-loud]]); this FR asks for the keyword, not a softer refusal.
acceptanceCriteria: minimum/maximum on integer+number properties enforce bounds.
cuj-schemas v0.0.1 validates the five shipped + four chrome 57 HATS CUJs mechanically.
